name: wp-soli-tv-plugin
description: WordPress plugin driving the automated TV display for Muziekvereniging Soli
author: Muziekvereniging Soli

scripts.i18n:make-pot: wp-env run cli -- bash -c 'php -d memory_limit=512M /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-tv-plugin wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-tv-plugin/languages/soli-tv.pot --domain=soli-tv --exclude=node_modules,e2e,test-results,playwright-report'
scripts.i18n:make-mo: wp-env run cli -- bash -c 'php -d memory_limit=512M /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-mo wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-tv-plugin/languages'
scripts.i18n:make-json: wp-env run cli -- bash -c 'php -d memory_limit=512M /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-json wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-tv-plugin/languages --no-purge'
scripts.i18n:build: npm run i18n:make-pot && npm run i18n:make-mo && npm run i18n:make-json

wordpress._comment: Oldest supported WordPress branch. The e2e suite runs against the newest patch of this branch as well as the newest release, and the release workflows stamp it into the plugin's 'requires'. Raise it when production no longer runs it.
